Type: desk
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Cross Legged Home Office Computer Desk Console, 42"W, White Gloss and Walnut
Colors: White/Brown
Materials: Wood
High gloss white lacquer finish and walnut veneer; silver hardware Versatile piece with one storage compartment and one drawer on the front This two-tone desk is anything but your ordinary workstation. Modern inspired design with a high gloss white lacquer finish is accented by warm walnut veneer, then mixed with crossed legs for a sleek, contemporary touch. 42"W x 15.7"D x 31.1"H Easy assembly in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
